messages:
mira: heads up — CI flagged a high-severity CVE in our base image layer (libssl). we need a coordinated rebuild + redeploy. thinking: rebuild image, run full vuln scan, push new tag, canary to staging, then prod roll. also need to validate KMS integration for image signing and update RBAC for the build SA. anyone object to that order? :eyes:

sam: +1 on order. i can open a pipeline MR to update Dockerfile base and bump tags. will add trivy + sbom + cosign signing step.

mira: thanks. sam, can you also add a step to rotate the KMS key used for signing? security wants key rotation within the window. question: who owns the KMS IAM changes?

sam: build-sa currently lives in infra. Proposed RBAC change: grant build-sa the kms.cryptoSignOnProject role only for the signing key resource. example gcloud iam policy-binding: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/keys/signer --member=serviceAccount:build-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.signBlob`

ada: audit log concern: if we rotate keys we must ensure audit logs show both create/sign and key-rotation events. also need to persist image provenance (cosign attestations) into our artifact registry. update cluster audit-policy to keep keymanager and imagepull events for 1y.

mira: ada — can you paste the audit-policy snippet you want?

ada: sure. snippet (k8s audit policy):
```
apiVersion: audit.k8s.io/v1
kind: Policy
rules:
  - level: Metadata
    resources:
      - group: ""
        resources: ["pods", "secrets"]
  - level: RequestResponse
    verbs: ["create", "update", "patch"]
    resources:
      - group: "kms.cnrm.cloud.google.com"
        resources: ["cryptokeys"]
    omitStages: ["RequestReceived"]
```
Also: enable objectRef.record for image pulls in kube-apiserver.

jonathan: runtime checks: after rollout we should run instrumentation to validate KV cache behavior and ensure no regressions in latency. canary window: 30m with 5% traffic, fallback policy to previous image if error-rate >1% or p50 latency +20%.

mira: noted. i'll add that to the runbook. we also need a vuln triage call if anything >7.0 CVSS shows up post-scan.

sam: CI MR opened: `gitlab.com/redwood/builds/infra/merge_requests/421`. added `trivy --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL`, `sbom generate`, `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/keys/signer`, and `upload attestations` to artifact-registry. job id: `build-1771`. deploy-bot: can you start a staging canary when build completes?

deploy-bot: CI build `build-1771` passed and image pushed: `gcr.io/redwood-prod/base:2026-03-15-1771`. starting canary deploy to staging. canary id: `canary-1771-01`.

ada: quick note: please ensure cosign attestation contains `signedBy: build-sa` and include `git.commit` + `pipeline.id` in predicate. that helps audits and forensics.

mira: RBAC change proposal (short):
- grant build-sa kms.signBlob on signing key (least privilege)
- add iam condition restricting to `resource.name` equals the key resource path
- create a read-only role for registry-attestations for security team
Anyone want to review before i put in terraform?

sam: lgtm. i'll add terraform snippet in MR: `google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member` with condition on member.

jonathan: can we also gate the rollout with OPA image policy that denies images without cosign attestations? want to avoid unsigned images creeping in.

ada: yes — sample gate: `compose check attestation predicate.git.commit` in gate config. i can add an OPA policy. will test in staging.

mira: schedule: rebuild + scan + sign (now) -> canary staging (canary-1771-01) 30m -> if healthy, ramp to 100% over 2h with monitoring. RBAC terraform MR and KMS rotation will be synced by infra.

sam: working on terraform MR now. estimate 1.5h to get KV and iam bindings ready.

ada: i'll update audit policy and OPA rego in a PR, test on staging cluster.

jonathan: i'll run the perf probe during canary and post results to this thread.

auditbot: compliance checklist update: [x] vuln scan in CI, [ ] KMS rotation scheduled, [ ] RBAC terraform MR, [ ] audit-policy updated, [ ] OPA gate enabled. tagging @security for visibility.

mira: thanks team. owners: sam (image build + RBAC MR), ada (audit + OPA), jonathan (canary perf checks). i'll run post-rollout incident watch for 24h. :thumbsup:

sam: started terraform apply in staging namespace (dry-run). ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:

deploy-bot: canary reached 5% traffic, 0.2% error-rate, p50 latency +3ms. continuing.

jonathan: perf snapshot: p50 baseline 28ms -> canary 31ms (+3ms). p95 unchanged. looks good. posting graphs: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/canaries/1771

mira: closing loop — will open a short postmortem if any regression. otherwise we'll proceed with production ramp tomorrow 09:00 UTC. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
